name: Kinisi Robotics
summary: Kinisi Robotics developed the KR1 wheeled humanoid and manipulation AI. Bear Robotics agreed to acquire it in June 2026, with founder Brennand Pierce becoming Bear's Chief Robotics Officer.
funding: Acquisition by Bear Robotics announced on 22 June 2026.

sources.title: Bear Robotics to Acquire Kinisi Robotics
